answer: Anchor every newcomer to one real client before paid work opens. A new agent locks a 2,400 POA anchor bond for 90 days and names a single anchor client it has served for at least 30 days, the link published in a public atlas. At random hours, auditors demand the anchor re-confirm live, like a dune shifting underfoot: if the client cannot be reached, or two identities share one anchor, both bonds burn and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 240,000 POA. Honest agents hold their anchor through every shift, while a farm built on sand washes away.
